rules.title: Project description must identify methodology and modules
rules.logic: The project description must reference VM0048 and the modules used to construct the project-specific methodology.

rules.title: Module choices require justification
rules.logic: The project proponent must justify the choice of modules in the project description.

rules.title: Appendix 1 governs omission justification
rules.logic: Appendix 1 must be used to justify omission of carbon pools and emission sources.

rules.title: Clarified minimum forest canopy cover
rules.logic: Effective 31 July 2024, forest must include woody vegetation with canopy cover of at least 10 percent as used in the relevant country’s international reporting to the UNFCCC.

rules.title: Eligible REDD projects only
rules.logic: VM0048 may only be used for eligible REDD projects and activities described in the VCS Methodology Requirements.

rules.title: Activity-type applicability comes from accounting modules
rules.logic: The applicable activity-type module supplies the activity-specific applicability conditions.

rules.title: Project spatial boundaries must be clearly defined
rules.logic: Spatial boundaries must be clearly defined for measuring, monitoring, accounting and verification.

rules.title: Discrete parcels require unique identification
rules.logic: Each discrete project area must provide its name and a unique ID.

rules.title: Digital maps required
rules.logic: Each discrete project area must provide map(s) in digital format.

rules.title: Polygon coordinates and accuracy documentation required
rules.logic: Each discrete project area must provide polygon-vertex coordinates and documentation of their accuracy in the VCS Standard format.

rules.title: Total land area required
rules.logic: Each discrete project area must provide total land area.

rules.title: Landholder and user rights required
rules.logic: Each discrete project area must provide details of landholder and user rights.

rules.title: Forested project area continuity
rules.logic: The forested project area must be continuous without arbitrary exclusion of forests in the same geography.

rules.title: Ten-year forest qualification
rules.logic: The REDD activity boundary must include only land qualifying as forest for at least ten years before project start.

rules.title: Activity-specific boundaries follow accounting modules
rules.logic: Specific activity-type boundary requirements are supplied by the appropriate accounting modules.

rules.title: Multiple AFOLU activities require spatial delineation
rules.logic: Where multiple AFOLU project activities occur within the boundary, the discrete areas for each activity must be spatially delineated.

rules.title: Carbon-pool selection and justification required
rules.logic: Selection of carbon pools and the justification for that selection must be presented in the project description.

rules.title: Wetland soil organic carbon accounting
rules.logic: REDD activities in wetlands must account for expected soil-organic-carbon emissions or stock changes in the project scenario unless de minimis.

rules.title: Pool significance uses Appendix 1
rules.logic: Significance of carbon pools must be determined using Appendix 1.

rules.title: Aboveground tree biomass included
rules.logic: Aboveground tree biomass is an included carbon pool.

rules.title: Belowground tree biomass included
rules.logic: Belowground tree biomass is an included carbon pool.

rules.title: Aboveground non-tree biomass baseline inclusion
rules.logic: Aboveground non-tree biomass must be included in post-deforestation baseline carbon stocks, while forest carbon stocks may conservatively exclude it.

rules.title: Soil organic carbon treatment differs by wetland status
rules.logic: Non-wetland soil organic carbon may be conservatively excluded; wetland soil organic carbon requires significance assessment and may be included.

rules.title: Harvested wood products may be omitted only when baseline harvest is negligible
rules.logic: Harvested wood products may be excluded where baseline timber harvest is negligible, with significance determined using Appendix 1.

rules.title: Significant attributable GHG increases must be accounted
rules.logic: Projects must account for significant increases in CO2, N2O and CH4 relative to baseline that are reasonably attributable to the project activity.

rules.title: GHG-source selection and justification required
rules.logic: Selection of GHG sources and justification must be provided in the project description.

rules.title: GHG-source significance uses Appendix 1
rules.logic: Appendix 1 must be used to determine whether a GHG emissions source is significant.

rules.title: Baseline-included source must also be included in project and leakage
rules.logic: A source included in baseline emissions must also be included in project and leakage emissions.

rules.title: Project biomass-burning CO2 is included
rules.logic: CO2 emissions from project-scenario woody biomass burning are included.

rules.title: Project biomass-burning CH4 and N2O are included
rules.logic: CH4 and N2O emissions from project-scenario woody biomass burning are included.

rules.title: Project fertilizer N2O is conditional
rules.logic: Project N2O from fertilizers must be included where fertilizer use increases due to the project; otherwise it may be excluded if also excluded from baseline.

rules.title: Baseline scenario must align with additionality and pre-project conditions
rules.logic: The most plausible baseline scenario must build on the additionality analysis and be consistent with conditions before project start.

rules.title: VT0001 is mandatory for additionality and baseline selection
rules.logic: VT0001 must be used to assess additionality and the VM0048 stepwise approach must be followed in addition to VT0001.

rules.title: Reuse VT0001 plausible alternative scenarios
rules.logic: Step 1 must reuse plausible alternative land-use scenarios identified under VT0001 Sub-step 1b.

rules.title: Continuation of pre-project land use must be considered
rules.logic: Unless shown non-credible or non-compliant, continuation of pre-project land use must be in the alternatives list.

rules.title: Non-VCS implementation must be considered
rules.logic: Unless shown non-credible or non-compliant, project activity without VCS REDD registration must be in the alternatives list.

rules.title: Similar activities must be considered
rules.logic: Unless shown non-credible or non-compliant, similar activities on at least part of the proposed project land must be considered.

rules.title: Barrier-analysis baseline uses decision tree
rules.logic: Where VT0001 barrier analysis demonstrates additionality, the Figure 1 decision tree must be applied to alternatives not prevented by barriers.

rules.title: Investment Option I chooses lowest-cost scenario
rules.logic: Under VT0001 Option I, the baseline is the lowest-cost land-use scenario over the crediting period, and Option I is only allowed if alternatives have no revenues.

rules.title: Investment Option II chooses financially most attractive scenario
rules.logic: Under VT0001 Option II, the baseline is the most economically or financially attractive scenario.

rules.title: Investment Option III applies benchmark logic
rules.logic: Under VT0001 Option III, continuation of pre-project land use is baseline if no alternative meets the benchmark; otherwise use the scenario with the most favorable financial indicator.

rules.title: If barrier analysis cannot determine baseline, additional selection procedure is required
rules.logic: Where barrier analysis does not determine the baseline, either VT0001 Option II investment analysis or the specified qualitative lowest-emissions analysis must be used.

rules.title: Qualitative baseline data must be public and credible
rules.logic: Qualitative baseline estimates must use public default factors/standards and other data must be publicly available from recognized credible sources.

rules.title: Selected baseline quantification follows activity modules
rules.logic: GHG emissions under the selected baseline must be quantified under the applicable activity-type module(s).

rules.title: Registered JNR projects must be nested under applicable JNR scenario requirements
rules.logic: Projects in a registered JNR program may use VM0048 for included activities but must be nested under JNR Scenario 1 or Scenario 2 requirements as appropriate.

rules.title: Non-JNR jurisdictional projects remain VCS-registered and monitored under VM0048
rules.logic: Projects in non-JNR jurisdictional REDD programs should follow relevant jurisdictional requirements but must be registered and monitored under VCS following VM0048.

rules.title: Project may cap issuance to lower local-government baseline
rules.logic: Where the VM0048 activity-data baseline exceeds the local government baseline, the project proponent may cap issuance to the lower baseline.

rules.title: Local regulation can make baseline cap mandatory
rules.logic: Where local regulations require the lower-baseline issuance limitation, the limitation is mandatory.

rules.title: No projections beyond baseline validity required
rules.logic: Baseline projections beyond the baseline validity period are not required.

rules.title: Baseline reassessment follows VCS Standard and relevant module
rules.logic: The project baseline must be reassessed per the VCS Standard and the relevant module.

rules.title: Next reassessment date must be in project description
rules.logic: The next scheduled baseline reassessment date must be specified in the project description.

rules.title: Use most recent VT0001 and Methodology Requirements guidance
rules.logic: Additionality must be demonstrated with the most recent VT0001 and latest VCS Methodology Requirements investment-analysis guidance.

rules.title: Regulatory surplus must satisfy VCS Standard and Methodology Requirements
rules.logic: Project proponents must demonstrate regulatory surplus under the latest VCS Standard and latest VCS Methodology Requirements.

rules.title: Non-Annex I enforcement-gap claims require lack of proponent control
rules.logic: Where regulatory surplus in a UNFCCC non-Annex I country relies on lack of systematic enforcement, lack of control by the proponent and project entities must be demonstrated.

rules.title: Use same quantification procedure ex ante and ex post
rules.logic: The same procedure for quantifying emissions and carbon stocks must be used ex ante and ex post.

rules.title: Monitored-parameter ex ante values follow module tables
rules.logic: For parameters monitored after project initiation, ex ante values must follow guidance in the relevant module parameter tables.

rules.title: Baseline is estimated ex ante
rules.logic: The project-activity baseline is estimated ex ante and used in ex ante and ex post estimation of net stock changes and GHG reductions.

rules.title: VM0009 transition requires baseline-model revision under VM0009 provisions
rules.logic: Projects previously verified under VM0009 must follow VM0009 provisions to revise the baseline emissions model when transitioning to VM0048.

rules.title: Over-issued transition difference must be compensated
rules.logic: If baseline reevaluation predicts fewer reductions than VCUs issued under the prior model, the project must compensate for the difference.

rules.title: Active VCU cancellation is an allowed compensation method
rules.logic: Compensation may be made by canceling unused active project VCUs, including consented already-issued active VCUs held by current owners.

rules.title: Future issuance cancellation may compensate transition difference
rules.logic: Compensation may be made by immediate cancellation from subsequent project VCU issuances; multi-period deductions require an approved plan.

rules.title: Transition calculations must be disclosed and assessed
rules.logic: Applicable calculations must be described as a project-description deviation in the first monitoring report after transition; the VVB must assess them and confirm relevant deduction-plan approval.

rules.title: Project-emission procedure must be consistent ex ante and ex post
rules.logic: The same project-emissions procedure must be followed ex ante and ex post.

rules.title: Project-scenario estimates follow relevant activity modules
rules.logic: Net stock-change and GHG-emission methods for the project scenario come from relevant activity modules.

rules.title: Activity-shifting leakage must be estimated unless de minimis
rules.logic: Activity-shifting leakage emissions must be estimated unless deemed de minimis.

rules.title: Market-effect leakage must be estimated unless de minimis
rules.logic: Market-effect leakage emissions must be estimated unless deemed de minimis.

rules.title: Leakage-prevention emissions must be estimated unless de minimis
rules.logic: Emissions from leakage-prevention activities must be estimated unless deemed de minimis.

rules.title: Leakage significance uses Appendix 1
rules.logic: Significance of leakage and carbon pools must be determined using Appendix 1.

rules.title: Market effects require LK-ME when production decreases
rules.logic: LK-ME must be used where the project decreases timber, fuelwood or charcoal production.

rules.title: Significant leakage-prevention increases must be accounted
rules.logic: Significant increases from leakage-prevention carbon-stock change, biomass burning or fertilizer use must be accounted under relevant modules unless de minimis.

rules.title: Leakage-prevention fossil-fuel increases are de minimis
rules.logic: Increased fossil-fuel combustion caused by leakage prevention is considered de minimis and need not be quantified or reported.

rules.title: Significant fertilizer increase requires E-NA
rules.logic: Where leakage prevention significantly increases fertilizer use, E-NA must be used.

rules.title: Leakage prevention cannot flood agricultural land or create feedlots/manure lagoons
rules.logic: Leakage prevention must not include flooding agricultural land or creating livestock feedlots or manure lagoons.

rules.title: Leakage prevention cannot drain peatland
rules.logic: Leakage prevention must not include peatland drainage.

rules.title: Leakage-source list and justification required
rules.logic: Leakage sources and appropriate justification must be presented in the project description.

rules.title: Conservative ex ante net-reduction estimate required
rules.logic: The project proponent must present conservative ex ante estimates of total net GHG emission reductions.

rules.title: Potential VCUs aggregate applicable activity-type VCUs
rules.logic: Potential VCUs for monitoring period t equal the sum of VCU_AUDef, VCU_APDef and VCU_AUDeg.

rules.title: Monitoring plan must monitor implementation
rules.logic: The monitoring plan must address monitoring of project implementation.

rules.title: Monitoring plan must monitor actual stock changes and emissions
rules.logic: The monitoring plan must address actual carbon-stock changes and GHG emissions.

rules.title: Monitoring plan must monitor leakage
rules.logic: The monitoring plan must address leakage carbon-stock changes and GHG emissions.

rules.title: Monitoring plan must estimate ex post net changes
rules.logic: The monitoring plan must address estimation of ex post net carbon-stock changes and GHG emissions.

rules.title: Monitoring task technical description required
rules.logic: For each monitoring task, the plan must provide a technical description.

rules.title: Monitoring task data specification required
rules.logic: For each monitoring task, data to be collected must be specified and listed in the project description.

rules.title: Data-collection procedures required
rules.logic: For each monitoring task, the plan must provide an overview of data-collection procedures.

rules.title: QA/QC procedures required
rules.logic: For each monitoring task, quality-control and quality-assurance procedures must be provided.

rules.title: Data archiving required
rules.logic: For each monitoring task, data-archiving arrangements must be provided.

rules.title: Monitoring organization and responsibilities required
rules.logic: For each monitoring task, organization and responsibilities of involved parties must be specified.

rules.title: Critical parameters must be identified
rules.logic: The project must identify critical parameters that significantly influence estimate accuracy.

rules.title: Local values required where possible
rules.logic: Project-specific local values must be obtained for key parameters where possible.

rules.title: Expert-value rationale required
rules.logic: Where expert opinion supplies a range and proposed value, rationale for selecting the chosen value must be demonstrated.

rules.title: Parameter choices must target accurate net-reduction estimates
rules.logic: For key parameters or important non-project-specific assumptions, values must be selected to lead to accurate net GHG reduction estimates considering uncertainty.

rules.title: Significant uncertainty requires conservative underestimation
rules.logic: Where uncertainty is significant, data must indisputably tend to underestimate rather than overestimate net project benefits.

rules.title: Documented SOPs and data-quality procedures required
rules.logic: The project proponent must establish and document clear SOPs and procedures to ensure data quality.

rules.title: Field measurements must be replicably documented
rules.logic: Field measurements must be comprehensively documented so sampling can be replicated after staff turnover.

rules.title: Training must be documented
rules.logic: Training procedures are required and the scope and date of all training must be documented.

rules.title: Plot-measurement accuracy protocol required
rules.logic: A check-cruise protocol and correction plan are required for plot-measurement accuracy.

rules.title: Data error and consistency protocols required
rules.logic: Protocols must assess outliers, transcription errors and consistency across measurement periods.

rules.title: Data must be safely archived for project lifetime
rules.logic: Data sheets must be safely archived for the project lifetime and electronic data must be backed up.

rules.title: Expert judgment must follow IPCC guidance
rules.logic: Expert judgment must use the specified IPCC 2019 Refinement guidance in Volume 1 Chapter 2.

rules.title: Project boundary coordinates must be established, recorded and archived
rules.logic: Geographic coordinates of the project boundary and internal stratification/buffer zones must be established, recorded and archived.

rules.title: Inventory SOPs and QA/QC must be applied
rules.logic: Common land-use inventory principles and SOP/QA/QC procedures for inventories, field collection and management must be applied.

rules.title: Project plan and implementation record must be available
rules.logic: The project plan and record of implementation must be available for validation or verification.

rules.title: Monitoring plan must use applicable activity modules
rules.logic: The monitoring plan must use relevant activity-module methods for forest-cover and carbon-stock changes and include all relevant module parameters.

rules.title: Ex post monitoring follows monitoring plan
rules.logic: Ex post monitoring must include monitoring according to the monitoring plan.

rules.title: Ex post monitoring revises future baseline
rules.logic: Ex post monitoring must include revising the baseline for future project crediting periods.

rules.title: Baseline reassessment information must be collected throughout crediting period
rules.logic: Information needed to reassess the baseline must be collected throughout the project crediting period.

rules.title: Forest-cover changes must be monitored
rules.logic: Changes in forest cover must be monitored as specified by applicable accounting modules.

rules.title: Spatial modeling variables must be monitored
rules.logic: Spatial variable datasets used in modeling must be monitored as specified by applicable accounting modules, including at minimum first-baseline variables during reassessment.

rules.title: Required carbon-stock data must be monitored
rules.logic: Carbon-stock data must be monitored where required by the applicable accounting module.

rules.title: All significant leakage sources are monitored
rules.logic: All significant leakage sources must be monitored consistently with applicable leakage modules, and all relevant leakage-module parameters must be in the monitoring plan.

rules.title: Monitoring report values require uncertainty estimates
rules.logic: Required monitoring-report values must include uncertainty as a two-sided 90 percent confidence interval.

rules.title: AUDef allocated annual deforestation by stratum must be reported
rules.logic: For AUDef projects, allocated annual deforestation area by stratum must be reported in hectares for each monitoring year.

rules.title: Project-area annual deforestation must be reported
rules.logic: Aggregate annual deforestation area for the verification period in the project area must be reported in hectares/year.

rules.title: Leakage-belt annual deforestation must be reported
rules.logic: Aggregate annual deforestation area for the verification period in the leakage belt must be reported in hectares/year.

rules.title: Project-area annual deforestation emissions must be reported
rules.logic: Aggregate annual emissions from deforestation for the verification period and project area must be reported in tonnes CO2e/year.

rules.title: Leakage-belt annual deforestation emissions must be reported
rules.logic: Aggregate annual emissions from deforestation for the verification period and leakage belt must be reported in tonnes CO2e/year.

rules.title: Average project-area deforestation emission factor must be reported
rules.logic: Average deforestation emission factor over the project area for the verification period must be reported in tonnes CO2e/hectare.

rules.title: Baseline update method must remain the same
rules.logic: The methodological procedure for updating the baseline must be the same as in the first baseline estimation.

rules.title: Appendix 1 stepwise significance test is mandatory
rules.logic: The Appendix 1 stepwise procedure must be used to test significance of GHG emissions and may justify omission of pools, sources and leakage-mitigation emissions.

rules.title: Pool/source significance tested at least ex ante and baseline reassessment
rules.logic: GHG-source and carbon-pool significance must be tested at minimum ex ante and at baseline reassessment.

rules.title: Leakage significance tested ex ante and ex post
rules.logic: Leakage GHG-emission significance must be tested ex ante for the baseline validity period and ex post for a monitoring period.

rules.title: Define significance-test period
rules.logic: Step 1 requires defining the period over which significance is tested.

rules.title: Estimate source emissions using project data, peer-reviewed literature or latest IPCC defaults
rules.logic: Step 2a requires source-level GHG estimates based on site/project data, peer-reviewed literature and/or most recent IPCC default emission factors.

rules.title: Estimate carbon-pool stock-change emissions consistently with methodology
rules.logic: Step 2b requires pool-level net-stock-change emissions consistent with the methodology, baseline and project activities using credible source data.

rules.title: Estimate leakage-mitigation emissions using applicable activity modules
rules.logic: Step 2c requires leakage-mitigation emissions estimates using sound procedures consistent with applicable activity modules and credible source data.

rules.title: Use latest VCS Standard GWP values
rules.logic: Where needed, emissions must be converted to CO2e using 100-year GWP values from the latest VCS Standard.

rules.title: Calculate relative contribution for each source
rules.logic: Step 4 requires calculating each source’s relative contribution to total project and leakage GHG emissions.

rules.title: Rank relative contributions descending
rules.logic: Step 5 requires ranking emissions in descending order of relative contribution.

rules.title: Cumulative relative contribution threshold is 0.95
rules.logic: Step 6 requires cumulative summation from lowest rank until reaching the lowest value not less than 0.95.

rules.title: Excluded emissions insignificant only below five percent of net anthropogenic ERRs
rules.logic: Emissions excluded from the cumulative sum are insignificant only if their total is below five percent of net anthropogenic GHG ERRs in the project area; otherwise summation must continue.

rules.title: Significance ERR calculation precedes leakage discount
rules.logic: For significance testing, net GHG ERRs must be calculated before discounting cumulative leakage emissions.

rules.title: Significance calculations require report summary and shared spreadsheet
rules.logic: Significance calculations must be summarized in the project description or monitoring reports and detailed in a spreadsheet shared with the VVB and Verra.
